[SWS_CRYPT_04207]
{DRAFT}
⌈
The function
ara::crypto::cryp::Crypto-
Provider::GetPayloadStorageSize
shall return the minimum required capac-
ity of a KeySlot for storing a CryptoObject defined by the provided
ara::crypto::
CryptoAlgId
and CryptoObjectType. The function shall return
•
kUnknownIdentifier
if the provided
ara::crypto::CryptoAlgId
is un-
supported or the provided
ara::crypto::CryptoAlgId
equals
kUndefined
.
•
kIncompatibleArguments
if the provided pair of
ara::crypto::Cryp-
toAlgId
and CryptoObjectType represents an unsupported combination.
⌋
